description: This file implements the bincount operation for tensors in the PyTorch library, including template functions for CPU computation with optional weights, input validation, and dispatching based on tensor types.

methods.name: _bincount_cpu_template
methods.description: Template function that computes the bincount for 1D non-negative integer tensors, optionally with weights, for CPU.

methods.name: _bincount_cpu
methods.description: Dispatcher function that selects the appropriate template instantiation based on tensor types and handles optional weights.
